name: hello Mac paint
description:
creation of the macOS "Macintosh" screensaver
(prev version https://www.shadertoy.com/view/fftSzl)
assets: Original Geneva 9 glyphs, MacWriteEmpty and MacPaintHello bitmaps, cursors and brush path are embedded in Common.
license: No explicit license in retrieved source or metadata; no additional rights asserted.
adaptation: GPU: original integer tables losslessly packed into an embedded 4x512 RGBA8 nearest-filtered data texture (LINEARTILE); fractional tables use exact constant lookups, eliminating V3D array scratch. CPU: original in-memory tables with explicit lengths and equivalent 2x2 inverse; reuse identical main/shadow cells and skip brush walks outside their conservative bounds. Original res/Common and Image bytes, scene math, artwork, camera, timing and resolution are preserved.
